scripts.start: node -e 'const http=require("node:http"),fs=require("node:fs"),path=require("node:path"),os=require("node:os");const port=Number(process.env.PORT)||8080,pidFile=path.join(os.tmpdir(),`medical-drone-delivery-web-${port}.pid`),root=path.resolve(process.cwd(),"../../web"),types={".html":"text/html; charset=utf-8",".css":"text/css; charset=utf-8",".js":"text/javascript; charset=utf-8",".svg":"image/svg+xml",".png":"image/png",".jpg":"image/jpeg",".jpeg":"image/jpeg"};process.title=`medical-drone-delivery-web:${port}`;const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{let pathname;try{pathname=decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url,"http://localhost").pathname)}catch{res.writeHead(400);res.end("Bad request");return}if(pathname==="/"){res.writeHead(302,{Location:"/html/login.html"});res.end();return}const file=path.resolve(root,"."+pathname);if(file!==root&&!file.startsWith(root+path.sep)){res.writeHead(403);res.end("Forbidden");return}fs.readFile(file,(error,data)=>{if(error){res.writeHead(error.code==="ENOENT"?404:500);res.end(error.code==="ENOENT"?"Not found":"Unable to read file");return}res.writeHead(200,{"Content-Type":types[path.extname(file).toLowerCase()]||"application/octet-stream","X-Content-Type-Options":"nosniff"});res.end(data)})});server.listen(port,()=>{fs.writeFileSync(pidFile,String(process.pid),{flag:"w"});console.log(`Web server running at http://localhost:${port}`)});const shutdown=()=>server.close(()=>{try{if(fs.readFileSync(pidFile,"utf8")===String(process.pid))fs.unlinkSync(pidFile)}catch{}process.exit(0)});process.on("SIGTERM",shutdown);process.on("SIGINT",shutdown)'
scripts.stop: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),path=require("node:path"),os=require("node:os"),{execFileSync}=require("node:child_process");const port=Number(process.env.PORT)||8080,pidFile=path.join(os.tmpdir(),`medical-drone-delivery-web-${port}.pid`);if(!fs.existsSync(pidFile)){console.log(`No web server PID file found for port ${port}`);process.exit(0)}const pid=Number(fs.readFileSync(pidFile,"utf8"));try{const command=execFileSync("ps",["-p",String(pid),"-o","command="],{encoding:"utf8"});if(!command.includes("medical-drone-delivery-web:"+port)){fs.unlinkSync(pidFile);console.log(`No managed web server is running on port ${port}`);process.exit(0)}process.kill(pid,"SIGTERM");console.log(`Stopped web server on port ${port}`)}catch(error){if(error.code==="ESRCH"||error.status===1){try{fs.unlinkSync(pidFile)}catch{}console.log(`No web server is running on port ${port}`);process.exit(0)}throw error}'
